item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A weakness has been identified in PipraPay 3.0.0. item.title: CVE-2026-124249 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response carried an already expired Set-Cookie header for it, using the Domain and Path attributes from the header without consulting the cookie policy. A server could therefore delete cookies belonging to other domains from a shared cookie jar, such as the one used by urllib's HTTPCookieProcessor. The fix consults the cookie policy before an expired cookie may delete an existing one, as required by RFC 6265 section 5.3.

item.title: CVE-2026-124850 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description:
Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | A SQL injection vulnerability exists in a database migration script in flowintel.
The migration process reads stored connector identifier values from the database and interpolates them directly into SQL statements without parameterization. An attacker who has previously written a malicious identifier value into the affected tables can cause arbitrary SQL execution when the migration is subsequently run during an application upgrade.
- Requires prior write access to the database to plant a malicious identifier value - Triggered automatically during a migration or upgrade operation - Can result in unauthorized data disclosure, modification, or deletion
Affected versions: flowintel prior to 4.0.0

item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | PrestaShop contains an authenticated PHP code injection vulnerability in the back-office Performance debug-mode configuration. item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.0 | In Eclipse Langium versions 3.0.0 and later, the langium-sprotty package does not HTML-escape diagnostic messages before rendering them in the default hover popup provided by `addHoverPopupHandler`. item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.4 | OctoPrint provides a web interface for controlling consumer 3D printers. item.title: CVE-2026-124683 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Eclipse Langium versions 3.2.0 through 4.4.0 contain an inefficient algorithmic complexity issue (CWE-407) in the opt-in IndentationAwareTokenBuilder and IndentationAwareLexer. When producing DEDENT tokens, the token builder recomputes line numbers by re-scanning the entire preceding document text. A document whose indentation changes on most lines then takes quadratic time to tokenize. Because tokenization is synchronous, a crafted document of a few hundred kilobytes can block the Node.js event loop for tens of seconds. That causes a DoS for every user served by the same process. Languages built with the DefaultLexer and DefaultTokenBuilder are unaffected.
